provenance.positions: entry i scores the token at score_from + i from the logits of the row before it; top1 is the highest logit (ties to the lower ID), margin its logit minus the second's, and the top-k columns are ranked by logit

rule.text: short answers: the served greedy answer equals the F32 reference's, or follows it until a token the F32 reference ranks within near_tie of its own (logits); free text: the F32 answer teacher-forced as a served chat renders it, mean |dlogprob| <= max(mean_floor, the worst variant rounded up to mean_step) and the share of positions whose top-1 differs from the F32 pass's <= max(top1_floor, the worst variant), over the BF16 and f64 runs scored against the F32 run like a server
